title: Multinomial Kummer carry bound: naive p^{v_p} ≤ kn is FALSE; correct bound (kn)^{k-1}

problemStatement.formal: For a prime p and the central multinomial coefficient C(kn; n,...,n) (k blocks of size n): the conjectured bound p^{v_p} ≤ kn is FALSE for k ≥ 3; the correct sharp clean bound is p^{v_p} ≤ (kn)^{k-1}, with v_p ≤ (k-1)·⌊log_p(kn)⌋.
problemStatement.plain: The binomial fact p^{v_p(C(2n,n))} ≤ 2n does NOT generalize to k ≥ 3 blocks as p^{v_p} ≤ kn, because the per-digit Kummer carry lies in {0,...,k-1} rather than {0,1}. The corrected bound is p^{v_p} ≤ (kn)^{k-1}.

knownResults: Multinomial Legendre/Kummer identity (p-1)·v_p(multinomial) + s_p(N) = Σ s_p(aᵢ) — verified in Erdos729LegendreMultinomial.lean (0 sorries, 0 axioms).

insights: The conjectured multinomial bound p^{v_p(C(kn;n,...,n))} ≤ kn is FALSE for every k ≥ 3. The binomial proof relies on each Kummer carry digit ⌊2n/p^i⌋ − 2⌊n/p^i⌋ ∈ {0,1}; for k blocks the per-digit carry lies in {0,1,...,k-1}.
Numerically the naive bound fails for k≥3 at essentially every n (verified k≤7, n≤14, all primes p ≤ N).
Corrected sharp clean bound: p^{v_p(C(kn;n,...,n))} ≤ (kn)^{k-1}, from v_p ≤ (k-1)·⌊log_p(kn)⌋. Verified numerically (k≤7, n≤14): 0 failures; worst observed v_p/log_p(N) ratio ≈ 3.47 < k-1.
The per-digit carry identity: with d=p^i, ⌊kn/d⌋ − k⌊n/d⌋ = ⌊k·(n mod d)/d⌋ ∈ [0, k-1] (since k·(n mod d) < k·d).
Chebyshev bridge survives: C(kn;n,...,n) ≤ (kn)^{(k-1)·π(kn)} and ≥ k^{kn}/poly, giving π(kn) ≳ (kn)·log k / ((k-1)·log kn); recovers parent bound at k=2.
